snippet.title: Dream Team Supreme: Super Supreme Trailer
snippet.description:
Pilot a giant robot against a horde of monsters in this co-op roguelike deck builder. Attempt each proc-gen run alone or with a friend. Draw from and build up 2 decks at the same time, plan the sequence of each turn, and plug in the best mods. You'll need a big brain, or two, to prevent the invasion!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3208500/Dream_Team_Supreme/

https://discord.com/invite/GaxP5z4hjn
